title.zh: Gemini 4 Neon 发布：定位在 Carbon 与 Hydrogen 之间
title.en: Gemini 4 Neon launches between Carbon and Hydrogen

summary.zh: Google 宣布 Gemini 4 Neon，定位为前沿级能力、更快完成端到端任务，覆盖复杂编程、知识工作与科学流程。官方博客日期为 2026-11-18。官方称在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 的 xhigh 档得到 61 分、总榜第 3，Vals Index 第 2。API 定价为每百万 token 输入 3 美元（缓存输入 0.15 美元）、输出 15 美元，上下文 100 万 token，提供四档 thinking。入口包括 Gemini API、Gemini for business、面向 Pro / Ultra 订阅者的 Gemini 应用，以及 Antigravity；同日也进入 Cursor、GitHub Copilot，并由 Vercel AI Gateway 提供 google/gemini-4-neon。Artificial Analysis 称这是 Google 七周内的第四个模型，Neon（xhigh）相对 Carbon 有小幅 Intelligence 提升，Cost per Task 约低 17%；官方则写在默认 high 档每任务成本比 Carbon 低 32%。两个口径不能混成「全面超过 Carbon」。Cursor 与 Copilot 的接入记为相关产品，不另立成一次模型发布。
summary.en: Google announced Gemini 4 Neon as a frontier-class model meant to finish end-to-end work faster, covering hard coding, knowledge work, and scientific workflows. The official blog is dated 2026-11-18. Google said Neon scored 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at xhigh, third overall, and ranked second on the Vals Index. API pricing is $3 per million input tokens ($0.15 cached) and $15 per million output tokens, with a 1M context and four thinking levels. It shipped through the Gemini API, Gemini for business, the Gemini app for Pro and Ultra subscribers, and Antigravity; the same day it also reached Cursor and GitHub Copilot, and Vercel AI Gateway listed google/gemini-4-neon. Artificial Analysis called this Google's fourth model in seven weeks, with a small Intelligence gain versus Carbon at xhigh and about 17% lower cost per task; Google wrote that default high is 32% cheaper per task than Carbon. Those figures use different settings and do not mean Neon beats Carbon across the board. Cursor and Copilot access are related products, not a second model launch.

brief.zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Neon，定位在 Carbon 与 Hydrogen 之间。API 定价输入 3 美元、输出 15 美元，已进入 Gemini 应用、Antigravity、Cursor 与 Copilot。
brief.en: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon, between Carbon and Hydrogen. API pricing is $3 input and $15 output, and it reached the Gemini app, Antigravity, Cursor, and Copilot.

why.zh: 这是该窗口最完整的一次模型发布，补齐了 Gemini 4 家族的中间档。评估数字来自官方与 Artificial Analysis，口径不同，需分开读。
why.en: The most complete model launch in this window, filling the middle Gemini 4 tier. Official and third-party scores use different settings and should be read separately.

label.zh: Cursor 宣布 Neon 上线
GitHub 宣布 Copilot 可用 Neon
